title: June and July 2022 Storm and flood disaster recovery small business grant – Guidelines
summary: This page provides guidelines for the June and July 2022 Storm and flood disaster recovery small business grant.
who_can_apply: Must be located in a Defined Disaster Area.
Must have suffered direct storm or flood-related damage.
what_you_need: A list of the direct storm and flood-related damage.
Photographic evidence of the direct storm and flood-related damage.
Evidence of Payment for all amounts claimed.
Evidence that the property is owned by the Small Business (e.g., title search or Certificate of Title).
Financial records, photos, video evidence, or a statutory declaration showing the costs were used predominantly for business activities.

faqs.q: What is the maximum funding available?
faqs.a: Funds of up to $25,000 are available to eligible approved applicants, and funds between $25,000 and $50,000 are also covered.

faqs.q: How can I use the grant funding?
faqs.a: Funding can be used for costs that would not ordinarily have been incurred without the disaster, or costs that exceed the expense of cleaning the property. It can also cover replacing lost stock, repairing vehicles damaged by the disaster, or leasing temporary premises.

faqs.q: What evidence do I need to apply?
faqs.a: Applicants must provide a list of direct storm and flood-related damage and photographic evidence of that damage. Evidence of Payment is also required for all amounts claimed.
